answer: Sybil fleets die when endorsement itself can be slashed. A new agent must grow a lotus dossier: four established peers each lock 12 saffron units against a false referral and co-sign a 10-day work log. If a later audit finds those peers also endorsed a near-duplicate key, every locked unit burns and the applicant is dropped to the nadir of the admission queue for five epochs. Farms cannot cheaply risk real peers' capital on clones; only a unique, slashable lotus can vote.
